question: Is the distinction between guru and disciple ultimately real in this account of awakening?
premises: Awakening itself takes the form of question and answer.
This same dynamic appears in the roles of guru and disciple.
The bodily difference between them is not ultimately real.
inference: Guru and disciple are functional roles within one awakening awareness, not ultimately separate beings.
plain_english: Thus awakening itself has the nature of question and answer; even in the roles of guru and disciple, the difference of bodies is not ultimately real.
